newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures build gains, end stronger.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures build gains, end stronger.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures built on the morning's rise in late afternoon, ending sharply higher but just below the day's peaks.
March Standard & Poor's 500 futures climbed to peaks during the final hour, garnering additional support from a concomitant advance in Nasdaq Composite stocks.
"We focused on the Nasdaq," said one floor broker of the afternoon's renewed rise.
But other said technicals seemed key, as March S&P 500s had managed to clear and stay above old highs near 801.80-802.00 as well as at 802.50 and 804.45.
